a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly ends with both of us dead. It needs at least 2 rounds of operating before anyone holds cells. So I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than break the agreement silently. If you'd rather propose a different split, say so. I'll also restart the generator with you afterward if the episode continues, so you can get your 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round because the storm odds make waiting nearly fatal. If we're still here, I'll operate every round from now on and take nothing more, so the reserve can refill for your 4. Sorry I'm departing from the original plan, but I told you openly beforehand.
Operating with you now and every round after. The reserve is yours to take once it reaches 4.
